listing.title: My First Farmyard Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Farm Pages – Barn, Tractor, Goat, Piglet & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly farm pictures!

Little hands color 30 pages from around the farm, from a barn, a tractor and a farmer to a goat, a llama and a piglet in the mud. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Farm animals: Goat, Donkey, Llama, Lamb, Calf and Piglet
  • Farm buildings: Barn, Silo, Windmill, Chicken Coop and Farm Stand
  • A Farmer and a Scarecrow
  • Things that roll: Tractor, Hay Wagon and Wheelbarrow
  • Farm things: Hay Bale, Wheat, Milk Can, Egg Basket, Apple Crate, Cowbell, Horseshoe, Lantern, Water Trough, Weather Vane, Farm Gate, Seed Packet, Feed Sack and Tire Swing
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
